app_subtitle: Upload a panel image — get instant AI analysis
drop_text: Drop your image here, or click to browse
about_text: Manhwa Webtoon Analyzer uses AI to break down your favorite chapters: detects panels, groups them into scenes, generates a story recap, detects mood and extracts the colour palette — all in seconds.
err_no_panels: No panels detected. Try a clearer image.
cold_start_msg: ⏳ Waking up the server — this can take up to 30 seconds on the first visit.
err_file_too_large: Image is too large (max 5 MB). Try a smaller image.
err_unsupported_format: This image format isn't supported. iPhone photos are often saved as HEIC — please convert to JPG/PNG first (Settings → Camera → Formats → Most Compatible), or take a screenshot instead.
err_timeout: The request timed out. The server might still be waking up — please try again in a moment.
err_rate_limit: Too many analyses in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
